{{Quote|For a slave, Orvax is the living hell of the galaxy. There is no worse place that I know of.|[[Mezgraf]]|<ref name="DT 2" />}}
'''Orvax IV''' was a [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Slaves were stored in dungeons here before being sold off to slave owners. The slave traders lived in the upper levels of the cities. Members of the [[T'surr (species)|T'surr]] [[Species/Legends|species]] worked as security staff.

==History==
[[File:Orvax_IV.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Slave market on Orvax IV.]]
[[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] assumed that [[Kilindi Matako|Kilindi]], a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] and fellow cadet of his at the [[Orsis Academy]], was from her [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]]. She told him that she had been a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] on Orvax IV, until she had killed the large family that owned her, and escaped, which caught [[Trezza]]'s attention.<ref name="TWoDM">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>

Following the [[Cleansing of New Plympto|Battle of Half-Axe Pass]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] deported captured [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Gender/Legends|women]] and [[Youngling/Legends|children]] there,<ref name="DT 2" /> and the planet became a hub of the slave trade during the Empire's reign.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|426|Orvax IV}}</ref> [[Dass Jennir]] and the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' attempted to [[Mission to Orvax IV|rescue]] [[Bomo Greenbark]]'s family,<ref name="DT 3" /> only to find that his wife [[Mesa Greenbark|Mesa]] had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] and his daughter [[Resa Greenbark|Resa]] sold to [[Dezono Qua]] on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]].<ref name="DT 4" />

It was on this planet that [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]] purchased [[Droopy McCool/Legends|Droopy McCool]], naming him "Snit".

==Behind the scenes==
On the Outer Rim map of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], Orvax IV is mistakenly placed in the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />
